\section{Preliminaries}
\label{sec:prelim}

\begin{defn}[Admissible potential]
\label{def:potential}
A scalar potential $V(x)$ is admissible if $V(x) \ge 0$ holds pointwise.
\end{defn}

\begin{lem}[Pointwise Gronwall estimate]
\label{lem:gronwall}
Every smooth scalar function $y(t)$ satisfying $y'(t) \le -\alpha y(t)$ satisfies $y(t) \le e^{-\alpha t} y(0)$.
\end{lem}

\begin{proof}
Multiply by $e^{\alpha t}$ and integrate on $[0, t]$.
\end{proof}

\section{Main Estimate}
\label{sec:main}

\begin{thm}[Exponential energy decay]
\label{thm:energy-decay}
Let $u(t,x)$ solve the damped waveguide equation with an admissible potential $V(x)$.
Then the total energy decays exponentially in time.
\end{thm}

\begin{proof}
Apply Lemma~\ref{lem:gronwall} to the waveguide energy functional.
\end{proof}
